XenotypeDef.label: Snow Elf
XenotypeDef.description: The Falmer as they were: pale elves of Skyrim's first age, who raised cities of white stone at Winterhold and Saarthal long before Ysgramor's fleet came. They were priests and spellwrights, servants of Auri-El, and they took the cold as a kind of courtesy. War with the Nords broke their empire, and the Dwemer finished it.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: The Falmer before the fall: pale, sighted, proud and sworn to Auri-El.
